pricing.details: Track Impact is free. Track Impact Pro 11 €/month (unlimited tracking and professional reports). Team Seat 18 €/seat/month, or 13 €/seat/month billed annually (162 €/seat/year, 21% off). Marketplace profiles are listed as one-time purchases from 118 € (exact profile prices were not itemised on the official page, so only that published “from” floor is shown).
